title: Dues Rate Card — Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements
content:
Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements are billed in dues set per tier and per enrolled system. The rate card below is the catalogue of those dues for all six Comfort Club tiers, together with the web-channel discount and the payment condition attached to monthly billing.

## Catalogue rates (USD)

| Tier | Annual dues, first system (per term) | Annual dues, each additional system (per term) | Monthly dues, first system (per month) | Monthly dues, each additional system (per month) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Comfort Club Basic | 149.00 | 99.00 | 13.45 | 8.95 |
| Comfort Club Silver | 199.00 | 139.00 | 17.95 | 12.45 |
| Comfort Club Gold | 249.00 | 169.00 | 22.45 | 14.95 |
| Comfort Club Platinum | 309.00 | 209.00 | 27.75 | 18.75 |
| Comfort Club Platinum Plus | 389.00 | 269.00 | 34.95 | 23.95 |
| Comfort Club Total Home | 479.00 | 319.00 | 42.95 | 28.45 |

## Channel and billing terms

| Tier | Web enrollment discount on first-term dues | Monthly billing requires card-on-file or ACH autopay |
|---|---|---|
| Comfort Club Basic | 0% | Yes |
| Comfort Club Silver | 5% | Yes |
| Comfort Club Gold | 5% | Yes |
| Comfort Club Platinum | 5% | Yes |
| Comfort Club Platinum Plus | 5% | Yes |
| Comfort Club Total Home | 5% | Yes |

## Reading the card

- The **first-system annual rate** is the dues for the first enrolled system when the agreement is billed once per term in advance; the **additional-system annual rate** is the dues for each enrolled system beyond the first, per system per term.
- The **monthly rates** are the per-month equivalents for monthly billing: one rate for the first system and one for each system beyond the first, per system per month.
- The **web enrollment discount** is a percentage off the dues of the first term of an agreement enrolled through the web channel. On Comfort Club Basic it is 0%, so a web enrollment on that tier carries no discount.
- **Autopay**: on every tier the card marks monthly billing as requiring card-on-file or ACH autopay.

### Points of comparison
- Each step up the tier ladder raises all four catalogue rates; no tier's rate is below the rate of the tier beneath it.
- The web enrollment discount is the same 5% on every tier from Comfort Club Silver to Comfort Club Total Home.
